actual: reconcile_snapshot defaults broker_authoritative=False and routers/qmt_strategy_ledger.py:339 omits it, so the read-only endpoint emits ERROR POSITION_MISMATCH (incl broker_quantity=0 with strategy_quantity>0) for the same broker truth that autorun (scheduler.py:4502 broker_authoritative=True) reports as WARNING; BUG-400 symptom resurfaces on the API surface.

description: backend/services/qmt_strategy_ledger/reconciliation.py::reconcile_snapshot (~132) takes broker_authoritative: bool = False (default). The autorun/scheduler path passes broker_authoritative=True (scheduler.py:4502) and caps strategy lots to broker truth, emitting WARNING-level UNBACKED_STRATEGY_POSITION/UNATTRIBUTED_BROKER_POSITION adjustments. But the read-only reconciliation HTTP endpoint (routers/qmt_strategy_ledger.py:339) calls reconcile_snapshot WITHOUT the flag and falls into the legacy branch (reconciliation.py:204-218) that emits ERROR POSITION_MISMATCH whenever strategy_qty != broker_qty (including broker_quantity=0 with strategy_quantity>0). The original BUG-400 evidence came from exactly this read-only API surface. Net: same physical broker truth yields WARNING via autorun but ERROR via the API, so BUG-400 (strategy-slot positions must be broker-authoritative) regresses on the read-only endpoint and misleads operators/monitoring.

events.note: Independent analysis confirmed read-only reconciliation defaulted to legacy non-broker-authoritative path. Fix makes broker-authoritative reconciliation mandatory, read-only router passes broker_authoritative=True, and regression tests assert WARNING authority adjustments instead of ERROR POSITION_MISMATCH. Scope expanded for docs/handoff/BUG-447-analysis.md per direct user instruction. No production services/DB/DDL touched.
Rebased fix branch onto latest origin/main. BUG remains open pending Tier2 review/merge; final fix_commit will be backfilled after merge close-sync.
